outcome_rationale: Across 18 investigated public sources (10 newly discovered and audited in W07-A4P across Zenodo, Hugging Face, and GitHub plus 8 sources re-verified from W07-A1), 300,536 raw rows and 186,170 unique review texts were examined. Every source with real review text either: (a) stripped all place names, coordinates, and cities prior to publication (`phamluan/vn_msa_sar_v3`, `VLSP2018-ABSA`, `mendeley:10.17632/dp8s59xnb7.1`, `pqthinh232`, `hienbm`, `Foody_review_nlp`), (b) contained zero geographic overlap with the 60 frozen POIs in Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, and Hạ Long (`zenodo:10.5281/zenodo.7967494` with 62,887 TripAdvisor hotel reviews across 1,497 hotels in Phú Quốc, Phong Nha, Cam Ranh, etc., and `ThanThoai9x/vietnamese-food-images` with 100% Hồ Chí Minh City rows), or (c) lacked a valid reuse license (`QUARANTINE_REUSE_UNCLEAR`). Scientific provenance and mapping standards were preserved without compromise, yielding `PUBLIC_REVIEWS_ACCEPTED = 0`. First-party collection via W07-A3 Google Forms and W07-A4H Assisted Collection remains the sole primary source for the 60-POI / 300-review corpus.

public_provenance_classes.PUBLIC_OPEN_LICENSED_DATASET_V1: Publicly published dataset with explicit open license (CC-BY-4.0 / CC0 / MIT / Apache-2.0) and verifiable canonical POI linkage.

investigated_sources.source_name: TripAdvisor Vietnam Hotel Reviews (An Dinh Van et al., Zenodo Record 7967494)
investigated_sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 (declared on Zenodo metadata; upstream origin TripAdvisor Vietnam)
investigated_sources.upstream_origin: User-generated TripAdvisor hotel reviews across Vietnam (Reviews.csv + hotel_coordinate.csv)
investigated_sources.research_reuse_assessment: Published on Zenodo under CC-BY-4.0 with open file access; however, upstream content originates from TripAdvisor hotel pages and 0 of the 1,497 hotels in Reviews.csv match any of the 60 frozen canonical POIs in Hà Nội, Đà Nẵng, or Hạ Long.
investigated_sources.download_or_crawl_mechanism: Direct HTTP download via Zenodo REST API of both published CSV files (`hotel_coordinate.csv`: 263,557 bytes, MD5 50fa8970a26ae513b8295bbcdfacd0b0, 3,910 hotel rows; `Reviews.csv`: 64,460,152 bytes, MD5 ebae7b018af787978b29cf15591b7e96, 62,887 review rows).
investigated_sources.audit_notes: Full parsing of all 62,887 rows in Reviews.csv joined with 3,910 hotels in hotel_coordinate.csv verified that Reviews.csv covers 1,497 hotels concentrated in Phú Quốc (17,781), Cù Dù/Lăng Cô (3,407), Phong Nha-Kẻ Bàng (3,354), Cam Hải Đông/Cam Ranh (4,450), Ninh Vân (2,788), Điện Bàn (2,340), etc. Exactly 0 hotels in Reviews.csv are within 500m of or match any of the 60 frozen canonical POIs (including 0 matches for Sheraton Hanoi, Somerset Grand Hanoi, InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort, Furama Resort, Vinpearl Ha Long resort, and Novotel Ha Long).

investigated_sources.research_reuse_assessment: Disqualified: synthetic templated hotel descriptions ('Thông tin về Khách sạn ...'), zero first-hand user reviews, and unspecified license.

investigated_sources.audit_notes: Contains 7,000 instruction/output pairs describing star ratings, room prices, and amenities; 0 user review texts.
